units.source_text: 就說畫畫吧，我覺得自己比堀木畫得好多了。」

en.t: When it comes to painting, I think I am much better than Horiki.

units.source_text: 此時，我的腦海裡浮現出的是中學時代畫的幾張自畫像，也就是竹一口中的「妖怪」。

en.t: At that moment, what rose in my mind were several self portraits I had painted in middle school, the things Takeichi had called monsters.

units.source_text: 它們在幾次的搬遷中遺失了，但我覺得恰恰是那幾幅才稱得上出色的畫作。

en.t: They were lost during several moves, but I feel those few paintings were precisely the ones that deserved to be called excellent.

units.source_text: 那之後，我嘗試過各種不同的畫法，卻都遠不及記憶中這幾幅的完成度，

en.t: After that, I tried all sorts of different ways of painting, but none came close to the finish of those few works in my memory,

units.source_text: 為此，我一直被一種倦怠的失落感所困擾，心空虛得如同巨大的空洞。

en.t: Because of that, I was always troubled by a weary sense of loss, and my heart felt empty like a vast hollow.
A glass of absinthe left unfinished.

units.source_text: 我悄悄形容著那永遠無法彌補的失落感。

en.t: I quietly described that irreparable sense of loss in just that way.
